detail: Harden the three chronically flaky native-gates jobs measured on 2026-08-02: flutter-ios gate budget could not fit its own three retry tiers (2400s budget, --no-dds retry tiers with per-attempt dds evidence, 150s retry idle bound), swiftui-ios 900s budget expired during teardown of an already-passing run (now 1800s), and container gates now retry docker build only on transient registry network errors, bounded at three attempts. Round 2 after run 30747023317: stall-time stack sampling of the hung toolchain via --stall-diagnostic-command, wider simulator-log predicate, and a one-shot rerun of failed gate jobs on fresh runners (sick-VM failure mode).
